testimonial.excerpt: Since moving to Hightide, I spend only about 10% of the time I used to on emails and booking administration.

story.quote: Since moving to Hightide, I spend only about 10% of the time I used to on emails and booking administration. Before, every enquiry meant creating a personalised quote by email and manually entering bookings into Excel spreadsheets, a shared calendar and OneNote. Only around 30–40% of those enquiries actually became bookings, so a huge amount of time was spent on emails that never led anywhere. We worked like that for years because we couldn't find a booking system that was both affordable and flexible enough for our business. Our surf camp packages aren't priced by nightly rates, so most systems simply couldn't handle the way we sell and price our packages. With Hightide, guests can now see the different package lengths, room types and options online and book exactly what they need without waiting for a personalised quote. At reception, our staff have a much clearer overview of bookings, payments, check-ins, check-outs and guest add-ons, making day-to-day operations much smoother and easier to manage. Hightide has allowed us to keep the way our business works while removing almost all of the manual administration that used to come with it. It's saved us an incredible amount of time, made life much easier for our team, and finally gave us a booking system that fits the way our business actually operates.

items.question: Can I sell individual dorm beds?
items.answer: Yes. You can sell individual dorm beds, shared rooms and private rooms as separate listings, each with its own availability and pricing.

items.question: Can the same room be sold alone and in a package?
items.answer: Yes. The same bed or room can appear as a standalone stay and as part of a surf package. When it is booked in one place, availability updates everywhere else it is offered.

items.question: Can lessons be scheduled on selected days?
items.answer: Yes. Lessons can be included for a full stay or added only on the days a guest needs them, as part of a package or through your Online Store.

items.question: Can guests book accommodation, lessons and extras together?
items.answer: Yes. Guests can combine accommodation, lessons, rentals, transfers and extras in one booking flow, whether they choose a package or build their own stay.

items.question: Can I create both fixed-date and flexible packages?
items.answer: Yes. You can publish fixed-date surf weeks alongside open-date packages or flexible stays, all from the same inventory.

items.answer: Partners can use trackable referral links or booking codes. Hightide attributes their bookings, supports paid-to-partner arrangements and provides commission and settlement reporting.

items.question: Can accommodation connect to Airbnb and Booking.com?
items.answer: Yes. Hightide supports channel manager integrations so accommodation availability stays aligned with platforms such as Airbnb, Booking.com, Hostelworld, Expedia and Vrbo.
